observation.visible_scene: A close-up, eye-level shot of a white plate piled with thick-cut golden fries (chips) set against a dark, blurred background. A vertical stream of orange-red ketchup falls from the top edge of the frame onto the fries. A rounded blob of ketchup already sits on a fry in the lower-left of the pile, and a second streak of ketchup runs down a more upright fry in the center.
visible_changes: In the early frames (1-8) the ketchup stream is a thick, continuous column that lands on the lower-left fry's existing blob.
From about frame 9 the stream becomes noticeably thinner and its contact point moves up to the central upright fry, where a new red streak begins to build on its top edge.

From roughly frame 17 onward the stream reduces to a very fine thread that intermittently breaks into a short pointed jet or a falling droplet, sometimes absent in a given frame while the poured ketchup on the fries remains.
Near the end (frames 36-41) a small additional ketchup dot appears on the uppermost horizontal fry.
The fries, plate, and background keep identical positions across all frames, indicating a static camera with no cut; only the ketchup stream and the accumulated sauce change.
outside_clip_unknowns: The source of the ketchup (bottle, nozzle, or hand) is entirely above the frame and never shown.
Whether the pour began before this excerpt or continues after it is not visible.
The reason for the stream thinning and the contact point shifting is not shown.
uncertain_details: The exact frame at which the stream's landing point transitions from the lower fry to the central fry.
Whether the momentary absence of the thin thread in some frames reflects a true break in the flow or motion blur / a droplet between samples.
The precise timing of the small ketchup dot appearing on the top fry.
